text:
michael: deploybot scheduled compact-quant:v4 for canary at 23:00 UTC in the night window. Preflight flagged a thermal/backoff note on a subset of runs. @lina @anya can we call pin vs proceed?

lina: saw ~3% p99 bump on the long-seq job in staging but median fine. traces point to an extra kernel wait on matmul for seq>8k. :thinking: perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood/compact-quant/v4

anya: recommend cordon/pin for region-eu while we triage. propose: `pin compact-quant:v4 --scope=region-eu --ttl=4h` then run targeted smokes for long sequences + kv-cache eviction. we'll also draft an RN note. :white_check_mark:

carter: agree with pin. need explicit rollback/unpin criteria before we pin though so oncall can act without extra back-and-forth.

michael: rollback criteria proposal: p99 > baseline * 1.05 OR error-rate delta >= +0.1% sustained for 10m. If either triggers, auto-drain and rollback to compact-quant:v3. Unpin only after canary stable for 2x baseline window. I'll run the smoke and post telemetry.

deploy-bot: deploybot: command accepted: `pin compact-quant:v4` scope=region-eu ttl=4h requested_by=@michael

lina: kicking off smokes now — workload: long_seq_10k, batch=64, kv_cache=on. logs will go to /artifacts/smoke-1717032100. ETA ~12m.

anya: RN snippet (draft): "compact-quant v4: reduced memory overhead and improved inference throughput on short sequences. Known: observed minor p99 regressions on very long sequences in early staging; pinned in EU night window pending investigation. PR: https://git.redwood/changelog/compact-quant-v4"

carter: solid. if smokes look green, we'll let canary proceed to a small staged slice at 00:00 UTC and consider extending pin ttl -> 12h only if stable. ping me if we need emergency rollback, otherwise i'll monitor the canary metrics dashboard. :eyes:
